fee_notes: Fee is $0.89 per Targeted Household (TH). Typical territory 45,000-70,000 THs yields $40,050-$62,300. Minimum franchise fee is $40,050 except for Community Heroes Program (up to 10% discount) and VetFran (20% discount of $40,050 = $32,040 minimum). Roll-In Discount 5% per $100k of existing business sales (up to 45%). Multi-Unit Franchisee Discount up to 20%. Additional Concept Discount 10%. HIRE Discount up to 25%.
